# Finance Month-End Close Procedure

Finance begins the monthly close on the first business day after month end and targets completion
within five business days.

1. Confirm that bank and payment-processor balances match the general ledger.
2. Review expenses above $10,000 and obtain the associated approval evidence.
3. Reconcile subscription revenue against active customer contracts.
4. Record accruals submitted by department managers before the day-three cutoff.
5. Have a second Finance team member review all manual journal entries above $25,000.

Close exceptions are recorded in the Finance Jira project. Material discrepancies must be
escalated to the Finance Manager before financial reports are distributed.
